title: Wso2am: max_age authentication-freshness check in OidcClientCodeRequestFilter was inoperative due to a…
description: A critical security vulnerability in wso2am versions prior to 4.7.0-r4 causes the max_age authentication-freshness check in OidcClientCodeRequestFilter to be ineffective due to a unit mismatch and inverted comparison logic. This flaw allows attackers to bypass the intended freshness check of authentication tokens.
